## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the reason for it.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests added or updated
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] `npm run build:worker` passes when Worker code or configuration changes
- [ ] Accessibility and responsive behavior reviewed where UI changes

## Privacy and authorization

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private Classroom content, or personal student data included
- [ ] Authorization is enforced server-side for any new data access
- [ ] User-visible claims match implemented behavior
- [ ] No production data, billing, OAuth, or deployment changes were made without approval

## Screenshots or evidence

Add only sanitized screenshots or test output. Remove private course and account details.
